text_simplified: This unit explains the importance of teaching children *murāqabat Allāh* (awareness of Allah’s observation) in all their actions, and warning them against *shirk* (associating partners with Allah). It recalls the story of Luqmān (peace be upon him) when he admonished his son and forbade him from *shirk*, clarifying that it is a tremendous wrong. It also emphasizes the necessity of instilling this *‘aqīdah* (creed) in the hearts of children so they may be ever mindful of Allah in all their deeds, especially in an age of widespread electronic devices.
